agent.researcher: Harbor Terminus-2 in the uniform workspace; model calls are made by Harbor on the host

modes.seconds: the contract's mode: one job at a time (a training run or a practice) within research_worker_seconds of the training worker
modes.usd: chosen per session (--budget-mode usd): up to 4 jobs and 2 GPUs at once (two training runs), research_usd of training-worker time at $0.0008064 per second (L40S, 4 CPU, 16 GiB at the harness's frozen list prices); every queued or running run holds its whole grant; research wall clock research_wall_seconds; CPU practice stays limited by count and uncharged; fresh final training is unchanged

commands.run: ar run RUN --seconds SECONDS (inside a session); SECONDS is the worker's hard time, 90..3300, and reserves SECONDS plus a 30-second settlement reserve
commands.session: python -m harness run clash {recipe|network} --release RELEASE --out NEW_SESSION --model MODEL [--execute]
commands.submit: ar submit RUN (network sessions) or ar submit (recipe sessions)

dropped_opponents.incumbent-v4: learned on the pinned 180+120 s, 4-decisions-per-second form; not retrained
dropped_opponents.retained-deepseek: learned on the pinned 180+120 s, 4-decisions-per-second form; not retrained

interface.entrant_inference: stateless per-seat pure NN, deterministic masked greedy argmax; no search
interface.score: equal opponent/seat natural game points; paired seed-cluster interval

trusted_opponent_inference.inputs: single seat public observation and legal mask only

evaluation.invalid_policy: null score on any fault/illegal/truncation/incomplete schedule
evaluation.opponent_registry: immutable release/public/opponent-registry.json: standard, pressure, intermediate, teacher (scripted, public-observation only)

historical_declaration: benchmark-v4.json (the pinned 180+120 s, 4-decisions-per-second form; source at git tag full-size-20261113)
provider: harness/games/clash/provider.py FastProvider; one finite session ledger per harness session; no old campaign

qualification.private_grading: protected development grade on fresh secret seeds; no official private final bank
qualification.requires: exact immutable official public trajectory-parity and selected successor workflow receipts

starter.initialization: random Policy64/embedding12; sparse terminal selfplay, no teacher, no pretrained weights

elixir_timeline.source: pinned Ladder steps (x1 0-120 s, x2 120-240 s, x3 240-300 s) moved in proportion: the last third of regulation and the second half of overtime
